g.title: rail_fat_tree
g.text: Rail-optimized fat tree: NIC k of every server plugs into the rail-k leaf; every leaf reaches every spine
Simplified: 4 servers × 4 rails shown (HGX servers have 8 GPUs, 8 NICs, 8 rails). One switch hop joins same-rail GPUs; three hops join any two GPUs.
